newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 9.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Thursday:
NEW YORK - Fifty-three people are arrested on charges they had participated in a scheme in which woudbe stockbrokers hired impersonators to take exams required to get a licence to sell securities.
WASHINGTON - A Yale University student pleads guilty to computer fraud for developing and distributing software that enabled people to use the America Online Inc computer service for free.
WASHINGTON - Federal traffic safety officials are not acting quickly enough to address the risks posed by passenger air bags in cars, congressional Republicans say.
DETROIT - Car manufacturers are trying to widen the market for sport utility vehicles for drivers who want four-wheel drive but not as much bulk.
